# Discovery contract fixtures

These files contain synthetic test observations, not measurements of a user computer or the build host. `linux-synthetic.json` uses invented CPU, memory, runtime, kernel, timestamp and scan values. `windows-synthetic.json` simulates Windows provider returns. `selected-folder-fixture.json` describes a generated test folder containing synthetic files.

Provider names model the wire contract; they do not claim that these synthetic values were observed from a real device. Actual platform test execution and its scope are reported separately in the versioned release evidence.
